assets.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. ONE finished transparent PNG title wordmark for a Bay Area hazard-alerts page (earthquakes, weather warnings, wildfires) on an 800x480 color e-paper display. Personality: urgent emergency-broadcast signage — simple, modern, minimal, unmistakably about danger and alerts. Exact text: "湾区要紧事" — five simplified Chinese characters 湾 区 要 紧 事, precisely this order, ONE horizontal line. Lettering: bespoke sharp, angular, heavy condensed Chinese display strokes with clipped 45-degree corners like modern safety signage, upright, tight even spacing, broad open counters. Color: flat solid signal-red letter faces (#e0201c), a thin white inline border hugging each glyph, then a continuous ink-black outer outline (#0b0f14) — so it reads on both a cream background and a dark navy background. Signature detail: ONE crisp jagged seismic fracture line runs horizontally through the middle of the whole word as a thin transparent cut, the upper and lower halves of every character offset by a tiny amount along it, like an earthquake crack; the characters must remain fully legible. No other ornaments. Every character must stay correct and immediately readable when the whole visible artwork is reduced to 200 x 46 pixels. Compact visible content about 4.3:1, modest transparent padding. Flat vector-like graphic only. No subtitle, Latin letters, numbers, separate icon, warning triangle, badge, enclosing border or box, shadows, glow, gradients, texture, 3D or checkerboard. True transparent alpha background and transparent letter gaps. One title only, large and fully inside the canvas.

Every character must stay correct and immediately readable when the whole visible artwork is reduced to 184 x 46 pixels. Visible content about 4:1 overall (the ring may extend slightly above and below the letters), modest transparent padding. Flat vector-like graphic only. assets.post_processing: gold pixels blended 70% toward #FFCE00 (native e-paper yellow); night variant recolors pixels darker than luminance 90 (navy outline, radar ring) to #BACEE8
